verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents a single Mail Send endpoint (POST /v3/mail/send) and a getting-started guide with copy-paste sample code via cURL or official SDKs, which covers the core of the story. Two parts of the story are not shown in the evidence: which fields are minimally required, and whether a message id is returned for tracking. Missing for 10: documented minimal required fields, evidence of a message id returned in the send response, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send a transactional email with one documented API call — minimal required fields, copy-paste quickstart code, and a message id back for tracking
